Standardization: within time, within subject, global, none. Evaluation metrics: silhouette, BIC full information-criterion family, entropy, posterior probabilities. Plots: state, sequence, trajectory views, combined grid, evaluation panels, flow transition networks via cograph. Tidy outputs: per subject, observation, state profile, trajectory, plus transition tables centralities. Automation every decision reported, interactive Shiny app.
